INSERT INTO `seo_clients` (`name`, `email`, `company`, `businessType`, `industry`, `createdBy`, `crm_client_id`, `isActive`, `createdAt`, `updatedAt`)
SELECT 
  c.name,
  c.email,
  c.name AS company,
  'real_estate' AS businessType,
  'Real Estate' AS industry,
  su.id AS createdBy,
  c.id AS crm_client_id,
  1 AS isActive,
  NOW() AS createdAt,
  NOW() AS updatedAt
FROM clients c
CROSS JOIN seo_users su
WHERE su.role = 'admin'
AND NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM seo_clients sc WHERE sc.crm_client_id = c.id
)
LIMIT 10;

SELECT sc.id, sc.name, sc.crm_client_id, sc.isActive FROM seo_clients sc ORDER BY sc.id;
